scripts.dev:source-index: cd services/source-index && PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m uvicorn source_index.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8100

scripts.validate:mvp: corepack pnpm validate && corepack pnpm check:docs && corepack pnpm --filter @lycium/web test && corepack pnpm test:e2e:manual-editing && corepack pnpm test:web-export-report && corepack pnpm verify:pages-export && corepack pnpm report:web-export && corepack pnpm check:web-export-budget && corepack pnpm test:api && corepack pnpm test:generation-evals && corepack pnpm test:source-index && corepack pnpm test:workers
